title: parietaria officinalis subsp. judaica
intro: Parietaria officinalis subsp. judaica, commonly known as Pellitory of the Wall, is a perennial herb belonging to the family Urticaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Parietaria officinalis subsp. judaica include its ability to reduce inflammation, inhibit histamine release, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
